description: This file defines the 'Column' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling autofilter column configurations and rules. It manages properties such as filter type, join criteria, rulesets, and attributes, providing methods to modify and access these properties and to clone the object.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a column in an autofilter, managing filter types, rules, joins, and attributes. Provides methods to manipulate filter configurations and supports deep cloning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Column with a specified column identifier (e.g., 'A') and optional parent AutoFilter.

methods.name: setEvaluatedFalse
methods.description: Sets the autofilter as unevaluated if the parent exists.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column index (e.g., 'A') for the autofilter column.

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column index after converting it to uppercase and validates it.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent AutoFilter object.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Assigns a new parent AutoFilter object.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Retrieves the filter type applied to this column.

methods.name: setFilterType
methods.description: Sets the filter type, validating against allowed types.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Retrieves the join connection type ('and'/'or') for rules.

methods.name: setJoin
methods.description: Sets the join connection ('and' or 'or') for rules after validation.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Assigns multiple attributes to the column.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a single attribute for the column.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes associated with the column.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific attribute.

methods.name: ruleCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rules configured for the column.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns an array of all rules.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Returns a specific rule by index, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: createRule
methods.description: Creates and adds a new rule to the ruleset.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Adds an existing rule to the ruleset and sets its parent.

methods.name: deleteRule
methods.description: Removes a rule by index and resets join to 'or' if only one rule remains.

methods.name: clearRules
methods.description: Removes all rules and resets the join to 'or'.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the object, including its rules.
